title: Air Conditioning — Cabin Air Risers — Installation of Broadband Absorber Inserts
abstract: Fitting of perforated absorber inserts inside the cabin air riser ducts on delivered aircraft, removing the tonal peak that passengers seated over the wing hear at cruise.

sections.planning_reason: Cabin noise surveys for three launch operators found a narrow tonal peak near 1250 Hz at the seat rows above the wing, produced by a standing wave in the riser ducts that feed the ceiling outlets. The peak is 6 dB above the surrounding spectrum and is the loudest single feature of the cabin air noise signature. Passenger survey scores for cabin quietness are consistently lower in those rows and one operator made the fix a condition of a follow-on order.
sections.description: Each of the eight riser ducts receives a perforated liner insert backed by a bulk absorber, sized to detune the standing wave without measurably changing the duct pressure drop. The riser accumulator is replaced by a shorter item to make room for the insert at the upper bend and the duct is re-clamped at a revised pitch.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the cabin ceiling panels over the centre section to open the ceiling void in zones 244, 265 and 293. Disconnect and remove the riser accumulator D2120111712496 at each of the eight positions and install the shorter item. Slide the absorber insert into the riser from the upper end until it seats against the stop, and check the seating with the inspection mirror from the tooling set. Install grommets AES557672-7B where the duct passes the ceiling void former and set the outlet flange standoff with spacers AES561134-8B. Re-clamp the duct with BRD511776-85 at the revised pitch given in the accomplishment instructions. Reposition the distribution clamp 3HQ by 25 mm. Do the cabin air distribution flow check at each outlet and confirm the flow is within tolerance. Install the ceiling panels and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00364 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00368 onward carry the inserts from build. Embodiment on a partial set of risers is not permitted because the acoustic result depends on all eight being treated.
sections.material_note: Kit K2120-1024-01 contains eight inserts, eight accumulators, the grommets, the spacers and the clamps. Lead time is twenty-two weeks. Removed accumulators are not returned. The insert cannot be steam cleaned; the revised duct cleaning procedure applies from the moment of embodiment.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next cabin refresh, or at the operator's discretion.
